demos.reasoning: The current date is Saturday, January 3, 2026. "This week" refers to the current week containing this date. Using Monday-Sunday week boundaries, the current week runs from Monday December 29, 2025 to Sunday January 5, 2026.

The phrase "next month" refers to the month immediately following the current month. Since the current date is January 15, 2026, the next month would be February 2026. This encompasses the entire month from the first day to the last day.

The phrase "end of January" refers to the final portion of January. Since we're currently in January 2026, this refers to the last few days of the current month. Typically "end of" a month refers to the last 3-5 days, so I'll interpret this as the last few days of January 2026.

The phrase "beginning of February" refers to the early part of February. Since no specific number of days is mentioned, I'll interpret this as the first week or so of the month, typically the first 7-10 days.
